name: Segmentation evaluation metric aggregation
summary: Aggregates a batch of CONNECTS segmentation evaluation metrics into per-metric means and population standard deviations, written as aggregate.json.
description: Averages every numeric metric in the raw and target_informed_neighbor_corrected groups across all input metrics files with equal weight per image, reports population standard deviation (ddof=0) and the count n per metric, and excludes missing values. Use it on one complete batch of seg-eval-metrics datasets; other metric groups are not pooled.

inputs.description: Segmentation evaluation metrics (metrics.json) for each image in the batch.

outputs.description: aggregate.json with per-metric mean, population standard deviation and n, plus team, batch and input dataset IDs.

parameters.description: Team name recorded in the aggregate output.
Batch identifier recorded in the aggregate output.
JSON array of dataset IDs, one unique ID per metrics file, in the same order.

failure_modes.message: Provide one unique dataset ID for every metrics file.
failure_modes.cause: input_dataset_ids does not list one unique ID per metrics file.
failure_modes.fix: Pass one unique dataset ID per input metrics file.

failure_modes.message: metrics must be an array of staged metrics.json paths.
failure_modes.cause: The metrics config entry is not a list of paths.
failure_modes.fix: Provide the metrics input as a multi-input list.
